{'component_name': 'CodeNest Monolithic Application', 'description': 'The CodeNest Monolithic Application is a single, unified deployment unit that encapsulates all system functionality for the Reusable Code snippet Repo. It provides a secure, user-friendly platform for IT service company employees to submit, edit, search, and manage reusable code snippets. The application enforces password-based authentication and role-based access control (admin, contributor, viewer), and all data—including code snippets, user information, audit logs, and analytics—is stored in structured JSON files on the server.

Key responsibilities include:
- User registration, login, and role enforcement
- Code snippet submission, editing, deletion, and version control
- Tagging, categorization, and metadata management
- Full-text and faceted search
- Commenting, upvoting, and activity feed
- Responsive, accessible UI for desktop and mobile
- RESTful API endpoints for UI and potential integrations
- Audit logging and download tracking
- Automated testing integration with Cypress
- Easy deployment and maintenance (single container, Docker-ready)

No external databases or authentication systems are used. The only external system is Cypress, which interacts with the application for automated end-to-end testing.', 'interfaces': [], 'framework': '', 'platform': '', 'container': '{
